instruction: Change the receipt image at /home/user/OIP.jpg to PNG format and save it as 'receipt.png' on the Desktop.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting JPG receipt image to PNG format and saving to Desktop. Evaluator checks if the output file exists and has PNG format. Custom getter reads the file from VM and extracts format information using PIL.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both instruction requirements: file existence and PNG format
Getter logic is correct: uses env.controller.get_file() to retrieve file from VM path '/home/user/Desktop/receipt.png', then uses PIL to extract format information
Metric logic is correct: checks existence with result.get('exists', False) and compares format with proper case normalization (.upper())
Expected parameter handling is correct: metric receives rules dict {'format': 'PNG'} directly and accesses it with expected.get('format')
Complete coverage: both requirements (existence + format) are verified
Edge cases handled properly: file not found, wrong format, and exceptions are all handled correctly
Data flow is semantically correct: right file path, right format extraction method, right comparison logic
